title: Welcome to EDUC 315
text:
This is the companion site for EDUC 315: Principles of Teaching Mathematics and Science in Urban Classrooms II at Howard University, taught by Professor Nathan Alexander. This site will serve as a companion to our Canvas site and support you with questions relevant to teaching mathematics. Let me know if you see any errors.
